race.comment: MORIKAWA (4) is the top pick after his Northam second, where he lost by half a length to Swing Bar as a well-supported favorite. His ninth at Ascot last week was below his best, but he was only three lengths behind in metro company. Now, he returns to easier competition with race fitness on his side and the rise in trip looking to hold the key. ASPEN READY (14) has trialled well coming into her debut. She's a half-sibling to the G1 winner King Colorado and the inside draw should see her get every chance. Can make an immediate impact. DON'T DECLARE (1) has placed in three of five starts and returned with a solid Northam third behind Snow Monkey, despite interference near the 200m. Pike sticks out to 1300m and he can make an impression. OUR SPICEMAN (6) improved sharply first-up at Northam, finishing a length and a half back at long odds, and with Chris Parnham riding, he has potential for further improvement. DANCE OF DRAGONS (3) won't be far away on resumption.
